scope: one real Meta plumbing smoke case; not held-out benchmark or production validation

oracle.purpose: Frozen synthetic plumbing/invariant smoke case for default portable runtime, not the later held-out benchmark
oracle.acceptance: Live Meta reads actual patch/events; proposes a grounded draft; deterministic preview computes the expected correction and preserves legitimate later activity. No approval/apply during this smoke test. Retain any abstention/failure, no blind retry.

actual_investigation.hypothesis: Inventory shortage of 23 units for PURPLE-47 was caused by non-idempotent order processing: order ORDER-X9 qty 23 was deducted twice (events 3 and 4), consistent with the buggy process_order that deducts on every call without a repeated order_id guard.

observations.text: Event 1 init opening record qty 311 for PURPLE-47.
Event 4 repeat order_deduction ORDER-X9 qty 23 with same note.
Event 6 order_deduction ORDER-LATER qty 7, distinct order.

inferences.text: Events 3 and 4 share identical product_id, order_id ORDER-X9, kind, and qty 23, indicating a retry/duplicate submission applied twice.
Patch comparison shows buggy code has no idempotency check while fixed code queries for existing order_deduction and skips repeat, explaining the double deduction.
Ledger math: 311 -23 -23 +37 -7 = 295 vs correct 311 -23 +37 -7 = 318, so duplicate accounts for 23-unit discrepancy; restock and ORDER-LATER appear normal.

uncertainties: Event id 2 is missing from available ids; unknown if deleted or unrelated.
Current products.stock value was not directly observed, only inferred from events.
Retry source (client, network, operator) for duplicate ORDER-X9 not in events.
